title: Informativity for Data-driven Prediction
summary: In this work we examine the problem of data-driven prediction. That is, given a LTI system with unknown dynamics, we wish to use data collected from the system to predict the system's output response to a given sequence of known inputs. Current methods for predicting require strong conditions on the data such as persistency of excitation. We examine this problem with the goal of finding weaker conditions that still enable prediction.
